clue.text: Preliminary plan not expected to be seen in a newspaper!

definitions.meaning: a detailed design drawn up before building

definitions.text: not expected to be seen in a newspaper!
definitions.meaning: smutty or risqué printed matter a family paper would not carry

explanation.definitionFit: An architect's design copied in white on a blue ground is a draft scheme, and 'blue' also means indecent, so blue print is printing unfit for a respectable paper.

clue.text: Hang about, it is included in the new role

indicators.note: one word is put inside the other
the letters of role are made new by rearranging

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An actor lingering about a part that features it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' shuffles the four letters of the actor's part into LOER, and 'included in' then sets the two-letter word inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger idly in a place is to hang about there.

clue.text: Being a separate thing

definitions.meaning: something with its own distinct existence

explanation.definitionFit: A creature or existent is a being, and also anything that exists as a distinct unit.

clue.text: Regarding money given to the poor regions

parts.note: re means regarding
alms are charitable gifts to the needy

explanation.surface: Concerning charity handed out to deprived areas.
explanation.definitionFit: Kingdoms or domains are areas, so regions is a synonym.

clue.text: It is his business so do not ask me about it

definitions.text: It is his business so do not ask me about it

parts.words: It is his business so do not ask me about it
parts.note: a description of the stock disclaimer someone makes when distancing themselves from another's affairs

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is said to disclaim involvement in an affair that belongs to somebody else.

clue.text: Way some workers go under

parts.note: suggests failing businesses, but describes the vertical tunnel colliers descend

explanation.definitionFit: Colliers descend underground through a vertical pit entrance, the route below the surface.

clue.text: Batsman can first use this in the kitchen

definitions.text: Batsman can first use this in the kitchen

parts.words: Batsman can first use this in the kitchen
parts.note: reads as a cricketer in a kitchen, but means a gadget for opening cans, a can being a tin and a first batsman an opener

explanation.walkthrough: The opening batsmen in cricket go in first; read 'Batsman can first' as a can-opening device.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen gadget that cuts the lids off cans is named by putting the British word for can before the word for a first batsman.

clue.text: Nominates another state

indicators.note: signals a different arrangement of the letters of nominates

explanation.surface: Someone puts forward a candidate for a different US state.
explanation.definitionFit: This Midwestern territory of the USA is one of the fifty states.

clue.text: Minimum cover for some holidaymakers

parts.note: sounds like a cheap insurance policy, but means the skimpiest swimwear worn on a beach

explanation.definitionFit: A two-piece swimsuit covers as little of the body as possible, worn by sunbathers on vacation.

clue.text: New origin, we hear, for dressing for lamb

parts.note: mint condition means brand new

indicators.note: signals that the following word is replaced by one pronounced the same

parts.note: a source is where something starts

explanation.surface: Someone claims a fresh start, sounding out the word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' turns SOURCE into its sound-alike SAUCE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp green herb condiment chopped in vinegar is the traditional British accompaniment to roast lamb.

clue.text: Retort about Joseph batting

parts.note: re means concerning or about
Jo is a short form of Joseph
a cricketer who is batting is in

explanation.surface: A sharp reply concerning Joseph while he is at the crease.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the side batting is 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean a quick answering reply, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Despatched people in it to show feeling

parts.note: something despatched has been sent

indicators.note: the word people is placed inside the word it

parts.note: taken as written
men stands for people generally

explanation.surface: People sent off inside something, to display emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: An emotion or attitude held towards something is a synonym of this word.

clue.text: Encourages good health

definitions.meaning: shouts support for, as a crowd does
a drinking toast wishing others well

explanation.definitionFit: Shouting support urges someone on, and the same word is said when raising glasses as a toast to wellbeing.

clue.text: The gradient is too much

parts.note: a hill described as rather sharp, and an idiom for something overpriced or unreasonable

explanation.definitionFit: A slope that is rather sheer is fairly sharp, and the idiom also describes a demand going too far.

clue.text: Noisy and love-struck after about 50

indicators.note: the lovesick word comes behind the other letters

parts.note: C is circa, about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
amorous means feeling love

explanation.surface: Someone loud and smitten in their fifties.
explanation.definitionFit: Loud and shouting describes something boisterous or noisy.

clue.text: Showing the clergyman over part of London

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits above the other

parts.note: Rev is short for reverend, a clergyman
Ealing is a district of west London

explanation.surface: Displaying a vicar above a London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: EALING is a borough in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposing or disclosing something is showing it.

clue.text: A few games of tennis become harder

definitions.meaning: a group of games forming one unit of a tennis match
to solidify, as jelly or concrete does

explanation.definitionFit: A tennis match is divided into units of several games, and jelly or cement goes firm as it hardens.

clue.text: Mineral spring not in the country

indicators.note: the word in is to be removed from the country

parts.note: Spain is a European country

explanation.surface: A source of mineral water found abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' removes IN from SPAIN, leaving SPA.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort with healing waters, named after a Belgian town, is a mineral spring.

clue.text: Abstainer takes in nothing, not even this

parts.note: TT means teetotal, an abstainer from alcohol
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A teetotaller refuses any drink at all, even a small one.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the rest: a teetotaller won't take even a small dram.
explanation.definitionFit: A small measure of spirits is what an abstainer would not drink at all.

clue.text: An item of protective clothing

parts.note: a plain description of a garment worn by police or soldiers to stop gunfire

explanation.definitionFit: A reinforced garment worn on the torso guards the wearer against shots from firearms.

clue.text: A book for the social worker

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A book written for someone in social work.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'social worker' is an insect living in colonies, not a council employee.
explanation.definitionFit: Worker insects live in highly organised colonies, so a colony insect is a social worker.

clue.text: Moderate anger

explanation.definitionFit: To tone down something tempers it, and a bad mood or rage is also called this.

clue.text: Arouse wild tribes

indicators.note: the letters of tribes are thrown into disorder

explanation.definitionFit: To rouse oneself into action is a synonym of arouse.

clue.text: Averts disaster only to die of hunger

indicators.note: the letters of averts are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone avoids catastrophe only to perish from famine.
explanation.definitionFit: To lack food until death is to perish from famine.

clue.text: Produce note in a wooden box

indicators.note: the note is placed inside the box

parts.note: a crate is a wooden box
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: Making a musical note inside a packing case.
explanation.definitionFit: To make or bring into being is a synonym for produce.

clue.text: Not on for queen and politician to have the collection

parts.note: off is the opposite of on
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
a Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Something is cancelled so a queen and an MP can take the money.
explanation.walkthrough: A Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: In a church service, money gathered from the congregation is taken during this part of the liturgy.

clue.text: Sensation from three quarters of the book or play

indicators.note: keep six of the eight letters, dropping the final quarter of the word

parts.note: a thriller is a suspense novel or stage play

explanation.surface: Excitement drawn from most of a novel or a drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three quarters of' cuts THRILLER, eight letters, down to its first six by dropping ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden wave of excitement is a feeling or sensation.

clue.text: Past student

parts.note: looks like a former pupil, but means a scholar who studies the past

explanation.definitionFit: A scholar of earlier times is literally someone who studies what happened before.

clue.text: Horsy sweetheart repeatedly holds a child of five

indicators.note: the doubled letter is split to hold the other piece
the letter from the heart of sweet is used twice over

parts.note: the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E
a quin is one of quintuplets, five born together

explanation.surface: A horse-mad lover keeps cuddling one of quintuplets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repeatedly' gives EE, and 'holds' puts QUIN between the two Es.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to horses is the meaning of this Latin-derived adjective.

clue.text: Encouraged to listen to number by newsman

parts.note: to hear is to listen to
ten is a number
ED is short for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: Someone cheered up by hearing a song from a journalist.
explanation.definitionFit: Being given heart and hope is a synonym for feeling encouraged.
